Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited to get procurement set up so we can issue POs and get your team live. To complete vendor master creation on our side we need the following items:

- Legal entity name exactly as registered (for 1099 / tax mapping)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or VAT number if applicable)
- Registered/legal address and a billing/remit-to address if different
- AP contact name, email, and phone (we'll route POs and invoice questions here)
- Preferred PO channel (email address to send POs, or e-invoicing portal info)
- Bank letter or voided check for ACH setup (we collect this before enabling electronic payments)
- Any mandatory invoice requirements (PO number required on invoice, special remittance references, etc.)

If you can reply with the documents as attachments (W-9 or W-8, bank letter), that will let our vendor operations team validate and create the record. Typical turnaround after we receive everything is 2–3 business days.

Also: do you have a preferred vendor code we should use on your invoices, or should we create a Redwood vendor ID?

Thanks —
Ben
